bls.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Population Survey, Table 11 (employed persons by detailed occupation, sex, race, and Hispanic or Latino ethnicity), 2025 annual averages (11-month average excluding October 2025), https://www.bls.gov/cps/cpsaat11.htm, accessed 2026-11-17

census.source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 Census: Hispanic or Latino 18.7%, Black or African American alone 12.4%, Asian alone 6.0% (census.gov/library/stories/2021/08/improved-race-ethnicity-measures-reveal-united-states-population-much-more-multiracial.html); non-Hispanic White alone 57.8% (2020 redistricting release); MENA alone or in combination about 3.5 million, classified as White (census.gov/library/stories/2023/09/2020-census-dhc-a-mena-population.html); Asian alone-or-in-combination groups Chinese except Taiwanese 5,205,461, Korean 1,989,519, Japanese 1,586,652, Asian Indian 4,768,846, Filipino 4,436,992, Vietnamese 2,293,392 (census.gov/library/stories/2023/09/2020-census-dhc-a-asian-population.html)
